items.question: What services does eCom Gliders offer?
items.answer: We provide full-service Amazon account management: PPC management, listing optimization and SEO, content writing, visual creativity, A+ and storefront creative, and catalog management. All services are delivered by our in-house team.

items.question: How is eCom Gliders different from other Amazon agencies?
items.answer: We are an in-house team of Amazon specialists, not a call center or software dashboard. Clients work with dedicated account managers who handle strategy, execution, and reporting directly.

items.question: What is included in the free audit?
items.answer: The free audit reviews your Amazon account health, listing quality, PPC performance, and growth opportunities. You receive actionable findings with no obligation to continue.

items.question: How much does Amazon account management cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on catalog size, ad spend, and scope of services. Request a free audit or contact us for a custom quote based on your brand's needs.

items.question: Do you work with new Amazon sellers?
items.answer: Yes. We support new sellers setting up Seller Central and launching first products, as well as established brands that need audits and growth plans for existing catalogs.

items.question: What marketplaces do you support?
items.answer: We support all official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

items.question: How do you manage Amazon PPC?
items.answer: We structure Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display around profitable keywords and ASIN goals, then optimize bids, search terms, and waste control on an ongoing cadence with reporting you can verify.

items.question: Can you help with account health or suspensions?
items.answer: Yes. We help diagnose listing suppressions, policy risks, and account health issues, then coordinate remediation steps. Outcomes depend on Amazon's review process; we do not guarantee reinstatement.

items.question: Do you create A+ Content and storefront creative?
items.answer: Yes. Our content and visual teams produce A+ modules, Brand Store layouts, and listing creative aligned to Brand Registry requirements and conversion goals.

items.question: How do you measure success?
items.answer: We track metrics aligned to your goals: revenue, ACOS, ROAS, organic rank, listing conversion rate, and catalog health. Reporting is shared on a regular cadence.

items.question: What is your client retention rate?
items.answer: Our client retention rate is 95%, based on verified company claims from the current site.

items.question: Is eCom Gliders an in-house team or an outsourced reseller network?
items.answer: All core services (PPC, listings, creative, catalog, and account management) are delivered by our in-house specialists. We are not a reseller of rotating offshore freelancers.

items.question: How long have you managed Amazon accounts?
items.answer: We have been helping Amazon sellers since 2018 and were established as eCom Gliders LLC in 2022.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a discovery survey, strategy call with audit findings, a custom plan, then onboarding and setup.
